title: Vexal Ping Compass
description: A lightweight Spigot/Paper plugin that gives players special compasses which point to the online player with the highest or the lowest ping. Useful for staff, events, or debugging network issues on your server.
body:
---

# 🧭 PingCompass

A lightweight Minecraft plugin that displays player ping using a **compass-like indicator**, helping players and server admins quickly visualize network performance.
Perfect for competitive servers, mini-games, or survival communities that value smooth gameplay.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🎯 **Compass-Based Ping Display** — See your ping visually represented through compass directions or colors.
* 📊 **Live Ping Updates** — Updates automatically as ping changes.
* ⚙️ **Customizable Display** — Choose between chat, action bar, boss bar, or scoreboard display.
* 🧩 **Optimized for Performance** — Designed to be lightweight and efficient on Paper, Spigot, and Purpur servers.
* 🔒 **Permission-Based Access** — Control who can view or use the ping compass.
* 💬 **Fully Configurable Messages** — Edit every message and color via `messages.yml`.

---

## 🧱 Requirements

* **Minecraft:** 1.16+
* **Server Software:** Paper, Purpur, or Spigot
* **Java:** 17 or newer

---

## ⚙️ Commands

| Command               | Description                                        | Permission          |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| `/pingcompass`        | Toggles the ping compass on or off for the player. | `pingcompass.use`   |
| `/pingcompass reload` | Reloads the configuration and messages.            | `pingcompass.admin` |

---

## 🔒 Permissions

| Permission Node     | Description                                          |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `pingcompass.use`   | Allows players to toggle or view their ping compass. |
| `pingcompass.admin` | Allows reloading the plugin configuration.           |

---

## 🧾 Configuration

```yaml
# PingCompass Configuration
settings:
  update-interval: 2  # seconds between ping updates
  display-mode: actionbar  # options: actionbar, chat, bossbar, scoreboard
  messages:
    prefix: "&6PingCompass &7» "
    ping-display: "&eYour ping: &a%ping%ms"
```

---

## 🪄 Usage

* Use `/pingcompass` to toggle your compass display.
* The compass or overlay updates automatically to reflect real-time ping changes.
* Admins can customize update intervals and display methods.

---

## 🧩 Compatibility

* Works seamlessly with **Paper**, **Spigot**, and **Purpur**.
* No dependencies required — simple drop-in installation.
